summary: Planted page sizes in a copy of the engine source. Standard sizes and paper names are caught and now pinned by a test; custom sizes, numbers with a unit and decimals are missed. The fix is a judge change, proposed in GG-049.

task: Phase 1: wrap modes and shaped objects
summary: Objects wrap as none, box, shape or jump, with an offset per side and their own minimum gap. Round insets, rotated boxes and cut-outs are sliced per line, and text can set inside a notch. Before and after pages for each mode. The editor's snapping is not built.

Page size, grid, page-count rule, export profile and asset packs are data on the document, and the engine holds no sizes. The newspaper preset's sizes are assumed until the printer's sheet arrives; what the printer has not told us is left empty.

task: Phase 1: document model, ops and undo
summary: An issue is plain data that changes only through ops, each with its undo as data. placeStory, setObjectGeometry and removeBlock pass the undo fuzz, and four inverses broken on purpose all make it fail. No screen uses this yet.

After D-037 the gate flags one line 8.3 pt off. The rendered PDF shows its ink starts exactly on the flow() edge; pdf.js extracted no text for the first conjunct व्य, so the check measured from the second व. Options (a) and (b) for Amal.

task: flow(): text on every side of a shape, aligned away from it (D-037)
summary: Engine change: gaps of 3 em or more beside a shape take text on both sides; lines beside a shape are flush left (shape on the right) or flush right (shape on the left), not justified. Before/after for five shapes: 5-32 more lines per page.

Every Phase 0 gate passes. GO: Pretext is the live engine. flow.png, the export route with the reviewer's conditions, what moves to Phase 1, links to every Phase 0 demo, and the commit, merge and tag commands.

task: G0.black prep: black text on the plates (E2)
summary: Test page through four Ghostscript routes, tiffsep plates. Plain CMYK puts black text on all four plates; rewriting neutral RGB to K keeps text, rules and tints on K and colour intact; BlackText also blackens colour text and panels. Photo reaches 296% total ink with the default profile. Not recorded: needs Amal's print check.

task: Font coverage rerun with real headlines
summary: 127 paragraphs plus 200 headlines, 112 distinct characters: none missing from Noto Sans, Noto Serif Devanagari, Khand or Eczar at 400 and 700. Of common news characters not yet in the copy, only ½ falls back in the Noto fonts.

task: Judge batch: raster right edges and headline parity
summary: G0.pdfpos right edges by raster on every justified line (p95 0.010 pt, worst 0.054 pt; worst line now gated). G0.headline active: Khand and Eczar bold, 200 real headlines, 99.95%, 0 overflows. Gate copy and measuring script locked. Waiting for approval.

task: Gate review decisions: G0.speed, G0.pdfpos, justify, font coverage
summary: Two gates added (speed 5.2 ms, PDF positions 0.009 pt). The 5 pt PDF outlier is a pdf.js artefact, shown by raster. Cheaper justify (spaces 0.8-1.33x, glyphs 98-102%) before and after. No character of the real copy is missing from the launch fonts.

task: Gate review: justify, PDF positions, speed
summary: Measured on real copy and proposed thresholds for three Phase 0 gates: justified word spacing, PDF line positions and font embedding, flow() speed on a full A3 page. No gate changed.
flow() now reports the space it leaves empty beside photos (red hatched): too narrow to take text, or the smaller side of a split line. Text placement is unchanged. Code is on branch phase0-black.
Text flows through columns and around photos. A gap beside a photo narrower than the minimum takes no text; the pages compare a minimum of 4, 6 (chosen) and 8 em.
